summary: A Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is entered into between ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a software development company, and John Smith, a software developer. The purpose of the agreement is to discuss a potential partnership while sharing confidential information. Confidentiality obligations last for 8 years after termination. The parties agree on intellectual property rights, liability, governing law, force majeure, and an entire agreement.

clauses.title: Definition of Confidential Information
clauses.description: Defines what constitutes confidential information shared between the parties.
